entry.title: Is There Still a Stigma Around Specialist Schools?

media:group.media:title: Is There Still a Stigma Around Specialist Schools?
media:group.media:description:
Is there still a stigma around specialist schools for autistic children? 🤔
When Bethany was diagnosed with autism, I knew I wanted her to attend a specialist school, and I fought hard to make that happen.
But I've often wondered why some parents feel so strongly about keeping their autistic children in mainstream education.
Every autistic child is different, and surely the most important thing is finding the right school environment for their individual needs, whether that's mainstream or specialist education.
I'd genuinely love to know what other parents think. Is there still a stigma attached to specialist schools?
#AutismParenting #SpecialistSchool #MainstreamSchool #AutismMum #SEND

entry.title: DLA Refusals: What Are the Government Figures Revealing?

media:group.media:title: DLA Refusals: What Are the Government Figures Revealing?
media:group.media:description:
Something is happening with DLA applications, and the latest government figures have raised some serious questions!
I've been looking into the number of Disability Living Allowance claims being refused, and the increase is something I think every parent applying for DLA should be aware of.
When applying for DLA for an autistic child, it's so important to understand exactly what the DWP is asking on the application form. Your child's care needs, supervision, safety risks and the extra help they need compared with other children their age all matter.
But do these figures actually mean it's becoming harder to get DLA? That's the question we need to be asking.
#DLA #DisabilityLivingAllowance #AutismUK #DLAApplication #AutismParents #dlaform ##dlahelp

entry.title: Why Does Respite Cause So Much Judgement?

media:group.media:title: Why Does Respite Cause So Much Judgement?
media:group.media:description:
Why does respite care for autistic children seem to cause so much judgement? 💔
As a mum to a child with autism and complex needs, I've experienced firsthand how difficult it can be to access respite support. Yet even when families finally get the help they desperately need, the judgement doesn't always stop.
Respite isn't something parents should be made to feel guilty about. Every autism family deserves understanding and support, regardless of what help they receive. ❤️
#autismparenting #respitecare #autismmum #sendparenting #autismsupport

entry.title: The truth about High Rate Mobility DLA for autistic children

media:group.media:title: The truth about High Rate Mobility DLA for autistic children
media:group.media:description:
High Rate Mobility DLA for autistic children is one of the most misunderstood parts of the DLA application process.
Under the Severe Mental Impairment (SMI) rules, a child does NOT have to have physical difficulties with walking to qualify. However, they must meet ALL six qualifying requirements, including entitlement to High Rate Care DLA.
Understanding these requirements before completing your child's DLA application or renewal is incredibly important.
My Higher Rate Mobility SMI Guide explains all six requirements in detail and is also included in my Autism Out Loud Community 💜
#DLA #HighRateMobility #Autism #AutismParent #DisabilityLivingAllowance #dlaform
